v1.3.6 Hotfix
🐛 Interaction Controls: Tile HUD launches now respect Direct, Private, and GM Select, and turning off GM-only advance restores player controls.
🐛 Hidden Dialogue and Choices: Players can advance hidden dialogue safely, while choices and votes reject stale or unauthorized responses.
🐛 Editor Saving: Node picker names, unchecked options, cleared node names, and deleted conditional branches now save correctly.
🐛 Targeted Stories and Jump: Story state stays within the selected audience, and Jump preserves private or targeted scenes while replacing the previous story cleanly.
🐛 Backlog Export: TXT and HTML exports now download normally.
🐛 Thumbnail Failures: Failed saves fall back to original portraits and repair missing thumbnail paths when possible.

announcement.title: 🌸 Visual Novel Maker v1.3.6
announcement.content:
Visual Novel Maker v1.3.6 fixes interaction controls, editor saving, targeted story privacy, and thumbnail failures.

  • Tile HUD modes and the GM-only advance toggle now apply correctly.
  • Hidden dialogue can be advanced safely, and stale or unauthorized choice responses are ignored.
  • Node picker names, unchecked options, cleared names, and deleted branches now save correctly.
  • Targeted stories and Jump actions preserve their intended audience and close the previous scene cleanly.
  • Dialogue Backlog TXT and HTML exports now download normally.
  • Failed thumbnail saves fall back to original portraits and repair missing paths when possible.
